descricao_original: This longitudinal section of cardiac muscle fibers demonstrates two of their distinctive features, centrally located nuclei and intercalated discs. Intercalated discs are complex cell junctions between the ends of adjacent cardiac muscle fibers. Components of intercalated disc cannot be resolved with the light microscope. 400x
